driver.phase_cycle_rule: explicit driver cycle when present; otherwise completed_cycles + 1 for in-cycle phases and completed_cycles for terminal phases

continuity_audit.scope: Checks logged native rendering/navigation continuity; neither frame presentation timing nor a universal FPS requirement.

periodic_sampler.offset_note: driver terminal elapsed minus sampler terminal-observation elapsed; undershoots actual start delay by terminal polling latency; not clock synchronization

active_coverage.method: driver Unix timestamps aligned with sampler UTC timestamps
active_coverage.clock_note: Wall-clock alignment; inspect driver/sampler wall-minus-elapsed drift. Sampler UTC is rounded to milliseconds.

interpretation_limits: Record consistency is not a universal memory/stability pass threshold.
Memory trends compare equivalent phase checkpoints; positive slope alone does not prove a leak.
Periodic maximum is sampled RSS, not the true process peak or GPU allocation ownership.
UI pointer validation and numeric-reference comparisons require their separate evidence.
No native presentation-latency p95 is inferred from driver wall time or RSS samples.
